The load has been reduced from 1kg to 750g! The "hand-drawn method" of holding a pencil and testing is no longer needed. 
【Features】
● The JIS K5600 standard has changed the load from 1kg to 750g.
● The "hand-drawn method," which involved holding the pencil by hand for testing, has been removed from the specifications.
● The main device is made of metal with two wheels, and the pencil is designed to press the paint film at an angle of 45±1 degrees with a load of 750g±10g.
● A level is equipped on the main body.
● The included pencil is a Mitsubishi uni certified by the Japan Paint Inspection Association.
● A Japanese calibration certificate issued by the manufacturer is attached. For customers who wish, a complete set of Japanese calibration certificates can be provided for an additional fee.
